start_gcode.label: Start Gcode
start_gcode.description: G-code prepended to every generated job.
start_gcode.default_value:
;----------- Start Gcode -----------
M2000 ;custom:line mode
M888 P1 ;custom:header is laser
M888 P14 ;custom:turn on cover fan
;-----------------------------------

end_gcode.label: End Gcode
end_gcode.description: G-code appended to every generated job.

transformation.label: Transformation
transformation.description: Position, size, and orientation of the model on the bed.

width.label: Width
width.description: Width of the model on the bed (mm).

height.label: Height
height.description: Height of the model on the bed (mm).

rotation.label: Rotation
rotation.description: Rotation of the model around its centre (degrees, counter-clockwise).

x.label: Move X
x.description: Horizontal position of the model centre (mm).

y.label: Move Y
y.description: Vertical position of the model centre (mm).

flip_model.label: Flip Model
flip_model.description: Mirror the model along an axis, or none.

optimize_path.label: Optimize Path
optimize_path.description: Reorder paths to reduce travel between strokes.

fill.label: Fill
fill.description: Fill closed shapes with parallel lines.

fill_density.label: Fill Density
fill_density.description: Fill lines per millimetre; accepts fractions.

working_parameters.label: Working Parameters
working_parameters.description: Speed, power, and pass settings used during the job.

dwell_time.label: Dwell Time
dwell_time.description: Pause before each laser-on pulse to stabilise the beam (ms).

engrave_time.label: Engrave Time
engrave_time.description: Duration of each laser-on pulse in dot mode (ms).

multi_pass.label: Multi-Pass
multi_pass.description: Run the G-code multiple times to reach deeper cuts.

passes.label: Passes
passes.description: Number of times to repeat the G-code.

pass_depth.label: Pass Depth
pass_depth.description: Lower the laser by this distance after each pass (mm).
